<entry id="J00301">
<head-word>יָחַס</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h. </language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="unknown">יָחַשׂ</xref>; 
<xref rid="H00408">v. חוּס</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to connect, be connected</italic>.</definition>

<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>יִחֵס, יִי'</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (denom. of יַחַס) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to trace the connection</italic> (יַחַס) 
<italic>of events or descent</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Meg. 17
<sup>a</sup> כדי לְיַיחֵס בהן שנותיו וכ' (Rashi: להִתְיַיחֵס) in order to trace through them the years of Jacob (in which the principal events of his life occurred); Yeb. 64
<sup>a</sup>; Yalk. Gen. 110. Ib.; Gen. R. s. 62 (ref. to Gen. XXV, 12 sq.) מה ראה הכתוב לייחס תולדותיו וכ' what reason was there for the Bible to insert here the genealogy of that &c.?—Snh. 82
<sup>b</sup> בא הכתוב ויִחֲסוֹ the Scripture comes and records his genealogy (Num. XXV, 11). Sabb. 55
<sup>b</sup> אפשר … והכתוב מְיַחֲסוֹ is it possible that he was a sinner and the Scripture would state his genealogy?; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to nobilize, distinguish, invest with prerogatives</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Num. R. s. 13 יִיחֲסוֹ הכתוב על שם שבטו the Scripture distinguished him (giving him the privilege of the first offering) for the sake of his tribe (Num. VII, 12). Gen. R. s. 82 אין מְיַיחֲסִין ליוסף וכ' not Joseph is ranked in the records as the first-born; a. e.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. מְיוּחָס, f. מְיוּחֶסֶת. pl. מְיוּחָסִים, מְיוּחָסִין; מְיוּחָסוֹת 
<italic>of traceable genealogy, of legitimate descent; of distinguished birth, well-connected</italic>. Hor. 13
<sup>a</sup> שזה מי' וזה אינו מי' for this one (the Israelite) is of legitimate birth, and the other (the bastard) is not. Kidd. 70
<sup>b</sup> משפחות מי' וכ' families in Israel of traceable descent. Ib. 71
<sup>b</sup> האי מי' טפי this one (who first ceased quarreling) is of nobler birth; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְיַיחֵס, </binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>Nithpa</italic>.</definition>
<notes> נִתְיַיחֵס </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to claim a pedigree</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Peah IV, 11 היתה מִתְיַיחֶסֶת עם וכ' ed. Zuck. (Var. על) claimed to be connected with Arnon, the Jebusite; Y. ib. VIII, 21
<sup>a</sup> bot. היתה מתי' של וכ' boasted to be descendants of &c.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be enrolled in genealogical lists, be recorded</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Num. R. l. c. זכו להִתְיַ' וכ' they were privileged to have their genealogy recorded by the side of Moses. Cant. R. to I, 1 נ' ראש לשלשלת יוחסין (not לשלשת) he was recorded as the starter of a chain of genealogy (I Kings XIV, 21). Gen. R. l. c. (expl. I Chr. V, I) לא לראובן להתייחס not to Ruben was genealogical priority to be given; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>2)</number>
<definition> (verb), impf. יוּכַל, 
<italic>to be capable, able; one can, may; it is possible</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Cant. R. to III, 6 לארי יָכֹלְתִּי … איני י' I overpowered the lion, and I should not overpower the dog? Ib. שר שלכם לא י' … ואתם יְכוֹלִים להם your guardian angel could not stand against their father (Jacob), and (you think) you could master them?—יְכוֹלְנִי = י' אני I can. Ḥag. 15
<sup>a</sup> top Ms. M. (ed. יכול אני); Nidd. 64
<sup>b</sup>.—Keth. 95
<sup>a</sup> מפני שי' לומר וכ' because he may plead &c. Ib. יְכוֹלָה היא שתאמר she may plead. Ib. 43
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. י' הרב לומר וכ' the master may (has a right to) say to his slave &c. Ber. 6
<sup>a</sup> אין כל בריה י' לעמוד וכ' no creature could stand up (exist) before the demons. Taan. 30
<sup>b</sup> ביָכוֹל of an able-bodied person.—Yalk. Esth. 1048 שמא תוּכַל להשיאה וכ' canst thou give her in marriage to both of them?—Midr. Till. to Ps. XLV לא יָכְלוּ להתודות וכ' they could not confess their sins with their mouth; a. v. fr.—Esp. יָכוֹל (= יכול אני לומר or י' אתה לומר) 
<italic>I</italic> (
<italic>you</italic>) 
<italic>might think, argue, conclude</italic>. Sabb. 64
<sup>a</sup> י' שאני מרבה וכ' from the Bible text (Lev. XI, 32) I might infer that ropes and cords are included; Sifra Sh’mini Par. 6, ch. VIII; a. v. fr.—כִּבְיָכוֹל 
<italic>as though it were possible, as it were</italic> (ref. to an allegorical or anthropomorphous expression with reference to the Lord). Mekh. Bo, Pisḥa, s. 14 כל זמן … כ' שכינה עמהם whenever Israel is enslaved, the Divine Majesty, as it were, is with them in slavery. Ib. כ' אמרו ישראל וכ' the Israelites said, thou, as it were, hast redeemed thyself. Ib. B’shall., Shirah, s. 6 כ' כלפי מעלה as if referring to the Lord’s eye. B. Kam. 79
<sup>b</sup>, v. מַטָּה; a. fr.—Ch. יְכִיל.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<pgbrk id="pg578" />v. מוּקְצֶה. Sabb. 29

<italic>nolad</italic> and must not be used as fuel. Erub. 46
